title: Model input settings and figure source data for volatile-assisted eclogite-pyroxenite lithospheric drips
description: Modified I2VIS flow-law function, model initial conditions (init.t3c), and figure source snapshots for Gou and Liu, Geophysical Research Letters: Volatile-Assisted Eclogite-Pyroxenite Lithospheric Drips: Implications for Andean Topographic Evolution and Magmatism. Display time in the figures is model time minus 50 Myr. The original I2VIS method is Gerya and Yuen (2003); the solver distribution cited in the manuscript is Gerya, Bercovici, and Becker (2021).
